caption: The drawing depicts a single circular bowl with a decorative handle attached to its rim at the top. The bowl is shaded to suggest a metallic or reflective surface, with concentric circles indicating its depth and form. The handle is ornate, resembling a crown with symmetrical, curving elements and cut-out sections for decoration. The drawing is done in grayscale, likely pencil, on a light beige or off-white background. In the upper left corner, there is a small inset sketch showing a side view of the bowl, labeled with dimensions "4 1/3" for length and "2 1/3" for height. The main drawing is framed by a rectangular border, and the artist's name, "Joseph Wolins," is written in small capital letters near the bottom right corner of the rectangular border.
title: Porringer
